title: Policies - Office of the Attorney General and Ministry of Justice
publisher: Office of the Attorney General and Ministry of Justice, Sierra Leone
why_not: An index page listing the justice sector reform strategy by title with no document link and no substantive text; fetched only to find an issuing-body copy of the strategy, which it does not expose.

title: PROCUREMENT PLAN (Textual Part) - Sierra Leone Digital Transformation Project (P177077)
why_not: A whole-of-project procurement plan whose only justice-specific entry, the e-Justice blueprint consultancy SL-MOFED-429645-CS-QCBS, records contract completion on 2025-06-16, before the window opens; the in-window fact is the plan revision, not the movement.

title: Sierra Leone Ushers in New Era Justice and Equality with Criminal Procedure Act 2024
publisher: United Nations Development Programme, Sierra Leone
why_not: An in-window commencement event, but its content is criminal procedure reform - committal timelines, competence of spouses as witnesses, non-custodial sentencing - with digital content limited to evidence by video link; it does not move a justice management information system.

title: Sierra Leone Productive Social Safety Nets and Youth Employment Project - Project Appraisal Document (PAD4672)
why_not: Fetched and briefly staged as the baseline, then withdrawn: the 50000-character capture reaches only the sector context, so SPRINT appears solely in the abbreviations list. Superseded by an existing staged technical note on SPRINT itself, which is adopted as the baseline instead.

title: Parliament Enacts Finance Act of 2026
why_not: An in-window enactment recorded by Parliament itself, but the release is a debate summary on tobacco, cement, petroleum and income tax rates; it does not mention ITAS, ASYCUDA, electronic cash registers or the customs single window, so nothing in it moves the tax MIS.

title: Strategic Development Plan - Sierra Leone Police (2025-2029)
publisher: Sierra Leone Police, hosted in the UNDP Sierra Leone publication repository
why_not: The intended baseline and the strongest available statement that police records remain paper-based with rural electricity and connectivity constraints; the fetch failed with CRAWL_NOT_FOUND and was not retried. The WAPIS equipment handover page was staged as the baseline in its place.
